summary: Frontend-only validation of Pulse Phase A (Landing timelapse) and Phase B (Map 3D view + Region Investigation panel) plus P2 polish (Get Notified CTA and feature-scoped SignUp modal). All P0/P1/P2 acceptance criteria pass. External Calescent v1.2 API (staging tunnel) responds within seconds and no cold-start issue observed.

issues: Watermark showed '43 frames' from server while spec/task said 42. Minor: the code doesn't hardcode 42 (uses frames.length) — server actually returns 43 frames at resolution=4h over 7 days. Not a bug in frontend; consider updating spec/copy if 42 is the intended contract.

critical_code_review_comments: SignUpModal: form input has no `name` attribute and submit doesn't post anywhere (documented placeholder behavior — expected).
MapPage: signalsOpen state defaults from window.innerWidth on first render — fine for SSR-less CRA but flag if SSR is added later.
AmbientHeat: interval 220ms × 43 frames ≈ 9.5s loop — matches spec.

Region panel absorbs bottom scrubber via right-3 offset (352px) — layout works but the scrubber container overlaps the region panel visually on smaller widths; consider a small responsive tweak (right=336px matches panel width).
MapPage regionCentre is cleared on view/mode/win/topic change (good), but is NOT cleared on percentile change — likely intentional but worth confirming.
